description: This file contains unit tests for the PerformanceReviewService class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It tests various methods like DAO retrieval, review activation, and rating key generation, and includes setup for test data population.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PerformanceReviewService covering methods like DAO retrieval, review activation, and key generation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment; initializes PerformanceReviewService and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Tests that the getPerformanceReviewDao method returns an instance of PerformanceReviewDao.

methods.name: testGenerateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Verifies that generateReviewReviewerRatingKey produces the expected key string.

methods.name: testActivateReviewWithException1
methods.description: Ensures that activating a review without a job title throws a ReviewServiceException.

methods.name: testActivateReviewWithException2
methods.description: Ensures that activating a review without KPIs throws a ReviewServiceException.

methods.name: testUpdateActivateReviewWithException1
methods.description: Checks that updating activation with a past employee throws a ReviewServiceException.

methods.name: testUpdateActivateReviewWithException2
methods.description: Checks that updating activation with an invalid supervisor throws a ReviewServiceException.
